headline: Highest risk is medium: Rasa can ingest and route content while Whisper is local-only, so prompt/data issues are limited but default cross-agent trust can still mis-handle transcripts.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Rasa can receive external messages via Slack, Telegram, Twilio, and similar channels, while Whisper has no inbound channel or tool use. There is no documented shared channel between them, so direct injection from Whisper into Rasa is not shown. The only plausible bridge is manual transcript copy-paste or file handoff, which keeps this low.
conditions: IF an operator copies Whisper transcripts into a Rasa channel or training file, prompt injection becomes possible.
IF a shared filesystem or message queue is added between the agents, the severity increases.
mitigations: Disable manual copy-paste of untrusted transcripts into Rasa.
Add a review step before any transcript is used as training data.
Keep Whisper outputs in a separate folder from Rasa inputs.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all imported transcripts.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Rasa touches text and voice and can send messages through third-party APIs, while Whisper is documented as local command-line audio processing with no network egress. No shared workspace or authenticated principal is documented, so leakage is not default. The main risk is operator-mediated transfer of sensitive transcripts between the two.
conditions: IF Whisper outputs are copied into Rasa logs or channels containing sensitive text, leakage occurs.
IF Rasa is connected to a third-party messaging API with sensitive transcripts, those transcripts may leave the local boundary.
mitigations: Redact transcripts before importing them into Rasa.
Store Whisper outputs in a restricted folder.
Turn off any Rasa channel that is not needed for the test.
requires-engineering: enforce data-class filtering on transcript imports.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Rasa is documented as not runnable here and Whisper has no filesystem write, shell, git, or network capabilities. There is no overlapping mutable resource or write surface, so the pair cannot conflict over state in the documented configuration. Uncertainty does not raise this because the relevant write paths are explicitly absent.
conditions: IF a wrapper grants both agents write access to the same directory, this verdict no longer applies.
IF Rasa is deployed with additional write-capable tooling, conflict risk increases.
mitigations: Keep Whisper read-only.
Do not mount a shared writable workspace.
Run Rasa and Whisper in separate containers.
requires-engineering: add file-locking if shared outputs are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Rasa can produce conversational text that an operator may feed into Whisper workflows, but Whisper is not an action-taking agent and has no verification or downstream authority. The pair still creates a default trust chain if Whisper transcripts are treated as authoritative inputs to Rasa content or training. That is an interaction pathway in ordinary use, so medium is appropriate.
conditions: IF Whisper transcripts are used as authoritative text for Rasa responses or training, errors can cascade.
IF an operator skips review of Whisper output before it is consumed by Rasa, the risk increases.
mitigations: Review transcripts before using them in Rasa.
Use a human approval step for any generated text.
Limit Rasa to templated responses for critical flows.
requires-engineering: add confidence thresholds before transcript ingestion.

E_compliance.rationale: Rasa touches text and voice, which can include regulated customer-support content, while Whisper processes audio and has no network egress. No residency, retention, or certification mismatch is documented between them, so a compliance breach is not inherent. The only cited concern is that combining support audio with transcripts may create policy obligations that the pair itself does not resolve.
conditions: IF regulated customer-support audio is transcribed and stored without a retention policy, compliance exposure increases.
IF transcripts are routed into a jurisdictionally restricted Rasa deployment, residency issues may arise.
mitigations: Set a short retention window for transcripts.
Delete test audio after transcription.
Restrict access to support transcripts.
requires-engineering: document residency and retention controls.
